_about: Reviewed boss abilities for the brain (odd/tasks/nqa-brain.md S1): each entry names its source page, the page's update date and the day it was read. Spell texts are Wowhead Forever tooltips by id. Add a boss only from a source read for it.

3654.name: Mutanus the Devourer

abilities.name: Thundercrack
abilities.text: Instant. Inflicts 475 Nature damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 2.5 sec.

abilities.name: Terrify
abilities.text: Melee range, instant. Terrifies an enemy, causing it to flee in fear for 4 sec. Only 1 target at a time.

abilities.name: Naralex's Nightmare
abilities.text: 30 yd range, 2 sec cast. Puts the target to sleep for up to 15 sec; any hostile action wakes it. Only one target at a time.

3654.advice: Appears after the Disciple's event. Two crowd controls; Thundercrack hits nearby targets hard (bad for melee). Bring ranged damage and a second healer if you can; healers stay at max range.
